description: Align worktree documentation with the main-checkout default. PR #1564 made the main checkout the default and made `/worktrees` § DECIDE the only copy of the worktree rule. Four documents still read as worktree-first:

userStories.title: Point the advisor section of AGENTS.md at /worktrees
userStories.description: As an agent that reads `AGENTS.md`, I want the advisor section to name `/worktrees` § DECIDE so that I do not assume a worktree.
acceptanceCriteria: The section `## One advisor, bounded workers` in `AGENTS.md` names `/worktrees` § DECIDE as the owner of the worktree decision.
`git diff <base> -- AGENTS.md` shows no change to `### 4. Parallel work does not share mutable state`.
userStories.notes: Main checkout, task branch. Executed: grep -c worktree boundaries printed 0; git diff f4305498d shows no change to section 4, grep count 0; pnpm exec vitest run behavioral-training-replay and unrequested-action-replay exit 0, 68 passed. Executed: grep finds /worktrees DECIDE in the advisor section.

userStories.title: Show the main checkout first in the README quickstart
userStories.description: As a new user, I want the quickstart to start work in the project clone so that I learn the default flow first.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -c 'Then ask for an isolated workspace' README.md` prints `0`.
The quickstart states that the agent works in the main checkout of the project clone by default.
The quickstart keeps `Create a worktree in <owner>/<repo> for issue #123.` as a request that the user can make.
The quickstart keeps the statement that each parallel agent gets its own branch and worktree.
userStories.notes: Main checkout, task branch. Executed: grep -c Then ask for an isolated workspace printed 0; grep finds line 306 main checkout default, line 311 worktree request, line 320 parallel statement.

userStories.title: Replace the worktree tips in the harness documents
userStories.description: As a harness user, I want the tips to match `/worktrees` so that the Claude Code and Codex documents give the same guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -c 'Use worktrees to' docs/harnesses/claude-code.md docs/harnesses/codex.md` prints `0` for each file.
Each of the two `## Tips` sections states that work starts in the main checkout and names `/worktrees` § DECIDE.
Neither document restates the § DECIDE conditions.
userStories.notes: Main checkout, task branch. Executed: grep -c Use worktrees to printed 0 for each file; grep finds the new tip in each Tips section. Reasoned: the diff has one line per file and restates no DECIDE condition.
